inlines.v: CONJUGAL, adjective [Latin , marriage; to yoke or couple. See Join and Yoke.] 1. Belonging to marriage; matrimonial; connubial; as conjugal relation; conjugal ties. 2. Suitable to the married state; becoming a husband in relation to his consort, or a consort in relation to her husband; as conjugal affection.
